headline: The problem is not that you don't have a website.
items: The site is done, but the person who built it no longer replies.
Changing a single banner takes three weeks and costs money.
The opening hours on the site are from last year, because nobody knows how to change them.
You don't know if anyone finds you on Google at all.
close: That is why every site I build is handed over with a panel where you log in and change the content yourself. Training is part of the price, not an extra.
